kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig file, or several separated by commas (Choose Kubeconfig picks one; empty: KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config)

debugImage.title: Image of the ephemeral debug container (Debug button on a pod)

allowRevealSecrets.title: Allow Show Secret and YAML on a secret (off: secret data is never read; on: YAML of a secret is shown unstripped)

yamlInEditor.title: Open YAML in an editor on a temp file in /tmp (off: YAML opens in the panel; on: the file is readable by other users of this machine, never used for secrets)

checkDeprecatedApiVersions.title: Report removed or deprecated apiVersions (extensions/v1beta1, batch/v1beta1, ...)

checkDuplicateEnvNames.title: Report an env variable defined twice in one container

checkMissingName.title: Report a built-in resource without metadata.name or generateName

checkMissingSelector.title: Report a Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet or ReplicaSet without spec.selector

checkHelmWhitespaceTrim.title: Report Helm whitespace trim markers written without a space ({{-foo, foo-}})

checkChartSchema.title: Report unknown Chart.yaml keys and invalid apiVersion, type, deprecated or version values

checkHelmExcessiveTrim.title: Report a Helm trim marker on an output that joins it to a neighbouring YAML line

checkKindSchema.title: Report an unknown top-level or spec key of a built-in kind (core, apps, batch, networking, rbac) and a kind its API group does not have

checkReadOnlyFields.title: Hint at fields the API server owns (status, metadata.uid, resourceVersion, ...) in a manifest

checkDeprecatedKeys.title: Report deprecated or removed keys (spec.serviceAccount, spec.rollbackTo, the ingress.class annotation, ...)

checkRequiredKeys.title: Hint at a key the API requires but a Pod, workload, CronJob, NetworkPolicy, claim or binding manifest lacks (spec.containers, spec.template, roleRef, ...)

checkFieldValues.title: Hint at a value of a built-in kind that is not one of the field's values (restartPolicy, Service type, strategy, ...) or not an integer or boolean where one is required

checkHelmValues.title: Hint at a .Values path in a chart template that values.yaml does not define

checkHelmIncludes.title: Report an include or template of a name that no define in the chart's templates provides

logViewerLines.title: Lines per pod the Log Viewer reads (10 to 20000)

notifySuccess.title: Show a notification when a command succeeds (errors are always shown)

nonKubernetesGlobs.title: Globs of YAML files that are not Kubernetes, separated by commas (no problems are reported for them), e.g. *.compose.yaml, ci/*.yml

checkChartKeys.title: Report a Chart.yaml without apiVersion, name or version
